# Pine Country Landscape

> Pine Country Landscape LLC is a locally owned residential landscaping and yard care company in Flagstaff, Arizona. Owner and customer contact: Rowan Brandenberg. Phone or text: (928) 863-8198. Website: https://pinecountrylandscape.com

## Services

- Yard cleanups and pine needle and cone removal, with all debris hauled away
- Pruning and shrub shaping
- Mowing, one time or on a schedule
- Weed control
- Debris hauling (dump trailer loads)
- Irrigation repair (leaks, heads, drip lines, zones)
- Sprinkler timer installs
- Sprinkler winterization and blowouts before the hard freeze
- Winter watering for trees and shrubs
- Tree and shrub planting and landscape design consultations
- Paver patios, walkways and hardscape, new irrigation (licensed contractor work)
- Holiday season 2026, "Christmas by Pine Country": Christmas tree delivery and setup. We bring the tree home on our trailer, carry it inside, set it straight in the stand and clean up the needles, and every install comes with a plate of cookies. Priced when Rowan replies to a request on the homepage form; a requested date is not reserved until Rowan confirms it. Also this winter: yard cleanups, junk removal, and on call snow removal
- Other landscape work (pavers, planting, irrigation, mowing) is on a spring 2027 waitlist
- Free plant doctor: photo diagnosis of struggling trees and shrubs

## Starting prices (typical Flagstaff lot)

- Yard cleanup: from $450
- Pruning and shrub shaping: from $295
- Mowing, per visit: $200 up to 1 acre, $275 up to 2 acres, $150 minimum for small yards (includes trimming, edging and blowing off walks and drives; over 2 acres priced in writing)
- Grass over 8 inches: $100 added to the mowing price
- Mowing clippings stay on the lawn; small area haul away of clippings or debris: $145
- Weed control: from $150
- Debris haul, dump trailer load: from $295
- Irrigation repair: from $185 (includes the first hour)
- Timer install: from $295
- Sprinkler winterization blowout: from $165
- Winter watering visit: $95
- Tree and shrub diagnosis visit: $95
- Design consultation (90 minutes on site, for bigger projects like pavers, hardscape and full yard installs): $150, credited toward the project
- On site estimate: free
- Plant doctor photo diagnosis: free
- Snow removal: on call only this winter (no season contracts), snow blower clearing of driveways and walks, $99 per snowfall for a standard driveway (2 car, up to 60 ft) plus walks; long or rural drives priced by text
- Estimates for jobs up to about $3,000 are free; bigger projects start with a $150 design consultation, credited toward the project

Final prices depend on size and scope and are confirmed in writing before any work starts.

## How to get a price or book

- Book an estimate: send the short form at https://pinecountrylandscape.com/#inquiry (name, phone or email, neighborhood or ZIP, and what you need; photos optional). Rowan follows up by text or email.
- Text (928) 863-8198. Texting is fastest; calls during jobs go to voicemail.
- Pick a time on the live calendar: https://pinecountrylandscape.com/#book
- Price from photos (ballpark by email): https://pinecountrylandscape.com/price-from-photos/
- Plant doctor: https://pinecountrylandscape.com/plant-doctor/
- Snow list (on call snow removal): https://pinecountrylandscape.com/snow-removal-flagstaff/
- Proposals and service agreements can be reviewed and signed online.

## Service area

Flagstaff, AZ and about 25 minutes out: Doney Park, Kachina Village, Mountainaire, Fort Valley, Continental, Cheshire, Timberline, Williams, Bellemont and Parks.

## Hours

Sunday, Monday, Wednesday, Friday and Saturday, 8am to 5pm. Closed Tuesday and Thursday.

## Good to know

- Licensed Arizona contractor ROC 368709 (CR-21 Hardscaping and Irrigation Systems).
- Insured (general liability and workers' compensation) and bonded.
- Crew has worked Flagstaff yards for about four years.
- Payment by card or cash.
